calibration_origin: frozen H100 tables; not recalibrated on RTX5090
limitation: Experimental non-P2P NCCL staged transport v2; single-node 8×RTX 5090 TP8/DP1, fixed synthetic input. Local producer completion precedes packet exchange and local decode. Original cross-GPU tile arrival/compute overlap is not preserved. R/C/CR3 host submission and buffering now belong to the staged implementation, not the H100 transport. Arrival tables and selective masks remain frozen from H100; this is not a 5090 calibration. Quantization policies may have different numerical trajectories. Each trial is reported separately; all slow windows and negative gains are retained. Bootstrap intervals describe this fixed workload and are not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
